entries.title: Identity providers beyond Keycloak
entries.summary: Okta, Entra ID and Auth0 sign-ins work without code changes. The API reads a machine client from a configurable claim, the UI can authenticate to the token endpoint with HTTP Basic and add authorize parameters such as an audience, and a new operations page gives a recipe per provider with a sign-in check.

entries.title: Findings, the orgs tree, fleet panels and Remediations
entries.summary: The Findings page lists every non-compliant result with filter chips, a drawer and CSV export. The orgs tree carries each cell's own denominator, the fleet panels read the history aggregates, and the Remediations page shows every pull request, API change and hold as a sentence. The status page counts the remediations waiting to run and carries this changelog.

entries.title: Remediation resumes and the controls grants
entries.summary: A reserved remediation resumes after a throttle instead of abandoning its branch, journaled reservations survive expiry, holds back off a day and the sweep is paced per installation. The worker roles can read the controls schema version. Icons are Tabler.

entries.title: Remediation
entries.summary: The Remediation App opens one pull request per control, applies or recommends API changes, and keeps every write behind the epoch fence. The API lists remediations and each repository's remediation.

entries.title: Repository page fixes
entries.summary: Failing rules read red, the breadcrumb names the repository, evidence lines are text and the stale badge sits beside the pull request (INV-0023).

entries.title: Controls evaluation
entries.summary: Policies are a directory of controls; each repository is evaluated against its resolved assignments.

entries.title: Repository page polish
entries.summary: The stale badge is spaced from the pull request link on the repository page.

entries.title: Design refresh
entries.summary: The DESIGN-0036 frontend — one surface, the tone table, charts, drawers and the keyboard pass.

entries.title: Fleet history refetch fix
entries.summary: The fleet view no longer refetches compliance history on every render.
